releaseNotes:
- Lunaverse Agent can now carry long-running creative work across parallel tasks and restarts, with clearer progress and safer recovery
- Character portraits now preserve identity, style, wardrobe, and transparency more reliably from casting through final delivery
- Production failures now retain their real cause and durable run state so the Agent can continue without duplicate paid work
- Imported projects can now be prepared naturally by the Agent when expected structure is missing, without rigid setup gates
- Cross-platform Agent, media, and production workflows are more reliable on both macOS and Windows
releaseNotesZh:
- Lunaverse Agent 现可跨并行任务与重启持续完成长流程创作，并提供更清晰的进度与更安全的恢复
- 角色立绘从真人选角到最终交付，现可更可靠地保持人物身份、画风、服装与透明背景
- 生产失败现会保留真实原因与可恢复的运行状态，让 Agent 能安全继续并避免重复付费
- 导入项目缺少预期结构时，Agent 现可自然补齐准备工作，不再被僵硬的初始化门禁阻断
- macOS 与 Windows 上的 Agent、媒体处理与素材生产流程现已更加稳定
